source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Commercial facts are source-reviewed against the book pages. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only; source prose is not reproduced.

relationships.note: The monthly market is run by the Suzuki family associated with the bodega, but takes place in a separate abandoned big-box store; the legacy parent link therefore means operation rather than physical containment.

entities.name: Honest Hiro’s Used Cars
entities.source_summary: Used-car dealership operated around the clock, normally keeping at least a dozen used vehicles ready for sale; supply comes primarily through the Steel Vaqueros.
entities.catalogue_note: The source guarantees used-vehicle availability but does not establish specific models. Keeping the stock source-local avoids inventing a model mix from the broader vehicle catalogue.

audit.note: Recovered during district review because the source explicitly establishes a used-car dealership even though it was not part of the 103 CORE_RETAIL count.

entities.name: Mrs. Suzuki’s Bodega
entities.source_summary: Flagship of a small family bodega chain, particularly known for Japanese foods and ingredients and for exclusive distribution of Shroomer-grown mushrooms and lichen.

audit.note: Direct source review supports food and ingredient retail, while the distinctive fungi remain local wares. The audit's electronics/fashion spillover is removed.

entities.name: Mrs. Suzuki’s monthly Night Market
entities.source_summary: Editorial label for the source-established Night Market run by the Suzuki family once per month in an abandoned big-box store; attendance is invitation-only for favored customers.
entities.catalogue_note: The source establishes the event and access model but does not define its merchandise, so no invented aggregate assortment is generated.

entities.name: White Side
entities.source_summary: Trading post near the Hot Zone frequented by scavvers; its explicitly dependable essentials are non-irradiated water and Kibble.
entities.catalogue_note: The source establishes a scavver trading post but does not identify a stable department mix. The v0.2 audit's weapons/armor/cyberware/vehicle spread is therefore not promoted into persistent catalogue stock.

audit.note: Direct review removes the audit's broad generated assortment and preserves only the source-supported essentials and scavver-trade identity.
